title: Terminal barrier is a property of Step, not of the state — ApplyEdit mutates terminal runs
detail: Two public mutation entry points enforce different guard sets: E17 is checked in Step only. An invariant enforced on one path but not the other is an invariant neither caller can rely on.
recommended_fix: Move the bTerminal (and tick-order) guards to a shared pre-mutation chokepoint both Step and ApplyEdit pass through.
